The '''Gimmut sewage tunnel''' was a large tunnel on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] that shunted sewage from millions of buildings into a waste processing plant called [[Osik Ocean]] by the [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorians]].<ref name="o66">''[[Order 66: A Republic Commando Novel]]''</ref>
